Studio Apartment for Sale in Carson B – DAMAC Hills

Discover modern living in this well-designed studio apartment located in Carson B, DAMAC Hills, one of Dubai’s most sought-after golf communities. Spanning 399.99 sq. ft., this unit offers a smart layout that maximizes space and comfort, making it an excellent choice for both end users and investors.

The apartment features a bright open-plan living and sleeping area, complemented by large windows that allow natural light to fill the space. The modern kitchen is fitted with quality cabinetry and finishes, while the bathroom is designed with contemporary fixtures for a sleek and comfortable feel.

Residents of Carson B enjoy access to a range of premium amenities, including a fully equipped gym, swimming pool, landscaped surroundings, and 24-hour security. The tower is positioned within DAMAC Hills, a vibrant community centered around the Trump International Golf Club, with easy access to parks, retail outlets, restaurants, and major road networks.

With its prime location, modern facilities, and efficient layout, this studio apartment presents a great opportunity to experience community living in one of Dubai’s most dynamic residential destinations.
